Karnataka High Court rules father must fund daughter's PG studies

The Karnataka High Court has ruled that a father must continue to fund his major, unmarried daughter's post-graduate studies, even after she turns 18. The court based its decision on provisions within the Domestic Violence Act. This ruling clarifies parental financial obligations for higher education in specific circumstances.
